jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Lead Production Scheduling

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to generate a detailed production schedule based on the production plan to maximize the use of resources and meet established production specifications and schedules. Each day, you will feed information on production capacity issues and material availability. You will also showcase your expertise by releasing manufacturing work orders.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Production Planning team within Motion High Power Solutions (MOHP) in Untersiggenthal, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are production, procurement, project management, engineering.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Creating and maintaining a detailed production schedule from the production plan.
  • Executing daily, plant-level Materials Requirement Planning (MRP) to create and manage production requirements to meet the production delivery schedules.
  • Establishing sequence and lead time of each operation to meet shipment dates per the master schedule plan.
  • Monitoring schedule adherence, identifying key root causes for deviation, and taking follow-up improvement action.

Our team dynamics
You will join a collaborative, experienced and supportive team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role
  • You have 3+ years of experience in production planning or scheduling in a manufacturing environment, ideally in an engineer-to-order (ETO) setting.
  • You are highly adept in SAP (PP/MM modules); experience with wayRTS/Planisware is a strong plus.
  • You enjoy working with structured production planning methodologies and have a solid understanding of MRP processes and capacity management.
  • You are passionate about structured problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Completed education at Höhere Fachschule (HF) level (e.g. Techniker:in HF) or equivalent, ideally in a technical or supply chain related field; a Bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • You are at ease communicating in German (fluent) and English (working proficiency).

Benefits
  • Flexible working hours and home office options
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • On-site gym and fitness programs to support your well-being and work-life balance

More about us
ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Within ABB, Motion High Power Solutions (MOHP) is a global leader in high-power, high-performance motors, drives, generators, power conversion and packaged solutions. At our Untersiggenthal site in Switzerland, we manufacture critical solutions for mission-critical applications with unmatched reliability and efficiency. ABB Untersiggenthal is a leading manufacturing site in Switzerland with a rich heritage of innovation and quality, committed to sustainable and responsible operations.
The recruiting process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, develop, and deliver technical training in person or remotely to participants across the globe. Each day, you will make sure to prepare highly qualified ABB and Channel Partner service personnel worldwide who are confident in their product knowledge, and ability to commission, service, and maintain Critical Power systems professionally and safely. Your focus will be the HiPerGuard MV UPS, UPS, STS, PDU, PCS and Battery Systems. You will also showcase your expertise by guaranteeing excellent customer service and securing a high level of customer satisfaction through training.

In this role, you will contribute to the Critical Power business line in the Electrification Smart Power division and be based in Quartino, Switzerland. The main stakeholders that support the development and delivery of training are Service, Product Management, Project Management, Engineering, and Sales.

You will join a dynamic, motivated, and high-performing global team where you can thrive.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Preparing and delivering training courses in classroom or on-site and following up on post-training day activities
  • Developing course material for classroom and on-site training in your own area of responsibility and advising on updates needed in e-learning material.
  • Supporting Field Service team and other teams/units, when necessary, using their own expertise in technical support tasks and roles
  • Facilitating course administration by coordinating arrangements, responding to inquiries, and preparing training course proposals



• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field
  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in power protection, service operations, engineering, testing, technical training, or related electrical/electronic disciplines
  • Experience in delivering technical training, knowledge transfer, or customer support activities is highly valued
  • Hands-on experience with critical power equipment and systems is considered an advantage
  • Additional education, certification, or practical experience in adult learning and training methodologies is preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to develop technical documentation, training materials, and learning content

  • Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel internationally up to 20% of the time

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

About the Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you are responsible for ensuring compliance with process workflows, work instructions, production plans, and quality and safety standards in a 3‑shift operation for the production of miniature circuit breakers (MCBs). You play a key role in maintaining smooth production operations. Working closely with the department management, you help create an effective and efficient working environment.

Work model: Onsite

Location: Electrification Business Area, Schaffhausen

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Managing capacities, resources, and personnel during the shift while ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and production targets

  • Acting as the primary contact for process‑related questions and ensuring compliance with defined process standards

  • Identifying improvement opportunities in production processes and equipment, and addressing technical, quality‑related, and logistical challenges with a solution‑oriented mindset

  • Motivating and developing the team, and collaborating closely with internal support functions to ensure efficient communication

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical apprenticeship

  • Several years of experience in production or production‑related areas

  • Initial leadership experience in a manufacturing environment

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and automated production lines

  • Experience with continuous improvement initiatives and Lean‑management methods (e.g., KAIZEN, Lean Six Sigma)

  • Strong analytical skills, resilience, and excellent team behavior

  • Fluent German skills (spoken and written); English skills are an advantage

  • Willingness to work in shifts (currently 3‑shift model, potentially including Saturdays)

  • Strong interpersonal skills and assertiveness

  • ERP knowledge (SAP)

What We Offer

We want you to bring your full potential — your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You will receive the tools and freedom to develop your skills, shape your own path, and take on challenges that truly matter. Your work will have a visible and tangible impact every day.

Benefits

• We offer a range of attractive benefits to support your well‑being and work‑life balance:

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year

  • Various discounts related to health and well‑being

  • Contribution toward gym membership

More About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Cluster Business Line Manager Industries, DACH


Key responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to adapt and implement the sales strategy for the designated area, in line with the global sales strategy. Each day, you will lead, develop, and coach a field-based sales organization, enabling a professional and sustainable front-end sales approach across direct and indirect channels in the DACH region. You will also showcase your expertise by driving sales development through the definition and execution of a regional sales strategy aligned with global business line objectives.

The role has a strong front-end sales focus within the ABB Robotics Business Segment Consumer Industries and covers the DACH region. You will operate in a multi-channel sales environment, working both in direct end customer engagement and indirectly via system integrators and partners. While the business is mainly product-driven, system solutions are also an integral part of the portfolio.

The customer landscape consists of a limited number of key accounts, complemented by a broad base of small and mid-sized customers, requiring a structured, scalable, and partner-oriented sales approach.

The work model for the role is: onsite / remote / hybrid. #LI-Onsite / #LI-Remote / #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributes to the Robotics Business Segment – Consumer Industries in DACH.

Main stakeholders are Sales, System Integrators, Channel Partners, Product Management, Regional and Global Business Line Management, and regional/country sales organizations.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Translating global sales and business line strategies into effective local and regional execution within a matrix organization.

  • Driving long-term business development and sustainable growth across the DACH region.

  • Leading and developing a geographically distributed field sales organization, fostering a modern, cooperative leadership culture.

  • Managing front-end sales activities across direct and indirect channels.

  • Steering front-end sales activities across direct and indirect channels and ensuring consistent sales execution.

  • Representing the DACH region in close alignment with global stakeholders and contributing regional market input to global strategy discussions.

Our team dynamics

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

Are you ready to make an impact with your sales expertise? As a Sales Engineer for Electrical Installation, you will be the main point of contact for our customers in the field of electrical installation products – including power distributors, intercom systems, and switches & sockets. In this exciting B2B role, you will support electricians and planning engineers across the German-speaking part of Switzerland, actively contributing to the growth of sales and margins.

You will work in a hybrid model (field sales & home office) and report to the Sales Manager for Electrical Installations based in Baden (AG). With your technical know-how and passion for sales, you will build long-term, strategically important customer relationships and sustainably develop your sales territory in Bern, Basel, and Solothurn regions (Switzerland).

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Manage your sales region: Provide expert advice to electricians in your area, supporting profitable growth.

  • Acquire new customers: Identify market opportunities, win new clients, and ensure an outstanding customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Grow with the team: Collaborate closely with extended sales teams to explore new market opportunities and contribute innovative ideas.

  • Work in a structured way: Maintain your sales activities and project pipeline consistently in ABB’s CRM system (Salesforce) – transparent and goal-oriented.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in technical sales and business development

  • Good market knowledge in electrical installation and an interest in modern topics such as building automation

  • Strong communication skills with a proven ability to build and maintain successful customer relationships

  • Completed apprenticeship as an Electrician or Electrical Installer (EFZ); further education at HF or TS level is an advantage

  • Native-level German; English skills are an advantage

  • Independent, structured working style combined with a strong customer and team-oriented mindset

  • Proficient in ERP and CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) as well as MS Office

  • Valid Category B driving license and a valid Swiss work permit

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus

  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you will have the opportunity to perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and in compliance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure high‑quality customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and carrying them out according to customer orders and expectations. With your clear communication skills, you help maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty by clearly conveying schedules and expectations.

Work model: Onsite

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Key stakeholders include customers, field‑service colleagues, and the internal service coordinator team.

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Collaborating with customers on‑site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Performing field‑service tasks, identifying technical issues, and conducting on‑site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Preparing material lists for service assignments and ensuring that all required materials, parts, and equipment are available and in proper condition

  • Providing training to field‑service colleagues and customers when required

Our Team

You will join a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, electrician, electrical installer, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Extensive knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and field‑service methods in an industrial environment

  • High customer orientation, flexibility in handling changing requirements, and a constructive approach to problem‑solving within the team

  • Fluent German and basic English skills; professional communication in customer interactions

  • Willingness to travel, participate in on‑call duty, and occasionally work on weekends; main service area: Mittelland / Bern region

  • Valid driver’s license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th‑month salary, and employee share acquisition program (ESAP)

  • Development opportunities through targeted training and career advancement

  • Company vehicle and fleet discounts

  • Contribution toward your gym membership and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA checks and Swibeco discounts

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. jobs.title: FPGA Software Engineer R&D – Power Electronics/Traction Applications
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

Division:

In our development center in Turgi we develop Power Electronic Converters for traction applications. We strengthen our position in the target markets with the continuous improvement of our products and technologies. With our innovative designs, we intend to open new markets and application areas. In the Control Software Group we develop powerful and reliable control software for Power Electronic Converters used in locomotives and train sets. We are looking for a technically experienced FPGA Software Engineer (m/f) who proves to be a team player in a very innovative and intercultural environment.

General Information:

Do you combine an excellent knowledge in Power Electronics Engineering with a proven record in complex FPGA subsystems for leading-edge applications? Are you keen to advance your career by joining a global player with a heritage of excellence? It’s time to rewrite your future – welcome to ABB!

Location: Turgi, Aargau, Switzerland

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Responsible for the development and the testing of complex FPGA Firmware (VHDL) for traction and auxiliary converters in railway applications

  • Feasibility studies, simulation, implementation, testing and documentation according to traction development processes

  • Provide technical support and advisory to internal customers

  • Work in interdisciplinary project teams with engineers from power electronics and control domains

  • Contribute and draft leading-edge development processes to enhance future success of the team


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree (MSc or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering or a related field

  • Proven experience in programmable logic design (VHDL) and strong expertise in FPGA architectures

  • Knowledge of power electronic systems is considered an asset

  • Experience in testing methodologies and software development processes is an advantage

  • Fluency in both written and spoken German and English is required

  • Structured, analytical work style combined with strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration in interdisciplinary project teams

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und das Testen komplexer FPGA Firmware (VHDL) für Traktions- und Hilfsumrichter in Bahnanwendungen

  • Durchführbarkeitsstudien, Simulation, Implementierung, Prüfung und Dokumentation nach Traktionsentwicklungsprozessen

  • Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung und Beratung für interne Kunden

  • Arbeiten in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Ingenieuren aus den Bereichen Leistungselektronik und Steuerung

  • Beitrag und Entwurf zukunftsweisender Entwicklungsprozesse zur Verbesserung des zukünftigen Erfolgs des Teams


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Degree (MSc oder gleichwertig) in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in programmierbaren Logikdesigns (VHDL) und starke Expertise in FPGA-Architekturen

  • Kenntnisse in leistungselektronischen Systemen gelten als Aktivposten

  • Erfahrung in Testmethoden und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen ist ein Vorteil

  • Fluenz in geschriebenem und gesprochenem Deutsch und Englisch ist erforderlich

  • Strukturierter, analytischer Arbeitsstil kombiniert mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die eine effektive Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams ermöglichen

< Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Platform Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


At Sevensense we push the frontiers of mobile robotics. Our mission is to build the eyes and brain for the robots of the future! Equipped with our technology, mobile machines can autonomously navigate in dynamic and crowded environments. Thus, we enable new robotic applications in places such as airports, supermarkets, warehouses and train stations.

We’re looking for a passionate Senior Embedded Platform Engineer to join our Embedded Platform team and help build the next generation of multi-camera and high-performance compute products. In this role, you’ll design, optimize, and scale systems that push the limits of real-time processing and edge intelligence.

You’ll be the go-to expert for electronics, owning our hardware designs and shaping the processes that take ideas from concept to production. Working closely with EMS partners, you’ll ensure exceptional product quality at scale, while collaborating with skilled design partners to bring innovative, cutting-edge systems to life. Along the way, you’ll create smart software and hardware tools to streamline manufacturing and dive deep into challenging, in-depth firmware development.

If you enjoy owning complex systems end-to-end and turning visionary ideas into robust, real-world products, this role is for you.

Your mission

  • Design prototypes for our next generation of products. Oversee prototype fabrication, including performing bring-up, debugging, and rework.

  • Maintain the portfolio of Sevensense products and handle change requests and component end-of-life situations. Additionally, collaborate with our EMS partners to ensure smooth production of our products.

  • Validate your designs through extensive testing of thermal, vibration, humidity, ESD, EMC, and electrical fault conditions.

  • Create test strategies and requirements for testing PCBAs & larger assemblies in production.

Your background

  • Acquired Electrical Engineering skills through a combination of a Masters degree in (Electrical) Engineering, work experience, or relevant projects.

  • Experienced with Altium, KiCAD, Autodesk Fusion/EAGLE or similar CAD programs for schematic capture, PCB design & maintaining component libraries.

  • Capable of simulating electric circuits in spice tools like LTSpice or similar.

  • Proficient with standard electronic lab tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, soldering irons, etc.

  • Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages: C, C++, Python

  • Basic understanding of the regulatory compliance process with industry standards for safety, EMI/EMC, and environmental regulations.

  • Responsible and detail-oriented team player who never wants to stop learning with a can-do mindset with the ability to take ownership of projects and drive them to success.

·Our offer

  • A unique opportunity to join a young and agile company which is now part of ABB

  • Multiple opportunities to develop your professional career and grow with the company

  • A competitive compensation package

  • A modern office in the center of Zurich

  • An ambitious, supportive and international team that is on a mission to change the world of robotics

If you are enthusiastic about bringing Sevensense to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our fast-growing team, apply online. We are interested in intellectually curious and highly motivated candidates so please reach out to us if you have questions or feel unsure about some requirements.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen. Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it: A ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più snella e più pulita. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per voi, la vostra squadra, e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, vi daremo quello che dovete fare per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, la crescita prende grinta. Ma ad ABB, non correrete mai da soli. Gestire ciò che dirige il mondo. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del business di ABB Robotics, una società di robotica globale leader. Stiamo entrando in un nuovo capitolo emozionante come abbiamo annunciato il piano per SoftBank Group per acquisire ABB Robotics. SoftBank è un gruppo tecnologico riconosciuto a livello mondiale e investitore/operatore focalizzato su AI, robotica e computing di nuova generazione. Unendoci ora, sarete parte di un team pionieristico che modella il futuro della robotica, lavorando insieme ad esperti di livello mondiale in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo. La nostra missione è quella di costruire gli occhi e il cervello per i robot del futuro! Dotato della nostra tecnologia, le macchine mobili possono navigare autonomamente in ambienti dinamici e affollati. In questo modo, possiamo attivare nuove applicazioni robotiche in luoghi come aeroporti, supermercati, magazzini e stazioni ferroviarie. • Stiamo cercando un appassionato Senior Embedded Platform Engineer per unire il nostro team Embedded Platform e contribuire a costruire la prossima generazione di multi-camera e prodotti di calcolo ad alte prestazioni. In questo ruolo, progettare, ottimizzare e scalare i sistemi che spingono i limiti dell'elaborazione in tempo reale e dell'intelligenza dei bordi. Sarete l'esperto di elettronica, possedere i nostri progetti hardware e modellare i processi che prendono idee dal concetto alla produzione. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i partner EMS, garantirai un’eccezionale qualità del prodotto in scala, collaborando con partner di design qualificati per portare a vita sistemi innovativi e all’avanguardia. Lungo il percorso, creerai strumenti software e hardware intelligenti per ottimizzare la produzione e immergerti profondamente nello sviluppo del firmware stimolante e approfondito. Controllare la fabbricazione di prototipi, compreso l'esecuzione di acquisizione, debugging e rielaborazione. Inoltre, collaborare con i nostri partner dello SME per garantire una produzione regolare dei nostri prodotti. Convalida i tuoi progetti attraverso un ampio test di analisi termica, vibrazione, umidità, ESD, EMC e condizioni di guasto elettrico. Capacità di simulare circuiti elettrici in strumenti di spezie come LTSpice o simili. Proficiente di strumenti di laboratorio elettronici standard come multimetri, oscilloscopi, analizzatori di logica, analizzatori di spettro, saldatori, ecc La comprensione di base del processo di conformità regolamentare con gli standard del settore per la sicurezza, EMI/EMC e le normative ambientali. Siamo interessati a candidati intellettualmente curiosi e altamente motivati, quindi per favore contattateci se avete domande o non siete sicuri di alcuni requisiti. Questo processo di reclutamento è guidato da Ceren Özen. Talent Acquisition Partner presso ABB Svizzera Ltd. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Applicare oggi o visitare www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

Ce rôle fait partie de l'activité Robotics d'ABB, une entreprise de robotique mondiale de premier plan. En vous joignant à nous maintenant, vous ferez partie d'une équipe pionnière qui façonnera l'avenir de la robotique, travaillant aux côtés d'experts de calibre mondial dans un environnement en évolution rapide et axé sur l'innovation.

Cette position fait rapport à:

R&D Team Lead


À Sevensense, nous repoussons les frontières de la robotique mobile. Notre mission est de construire les yeux et le cerveau pour les robots du futur ! Équipés de notre technologie, les machines mobiles peuvent naviguer de façon autonome dans des environnements dynamiques et encombrés. Ainsi, nous permettons de nouvelles applications robotiques dans des endroits comme les aéroports, les supermarchés, les entrepôts et les gares.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Embedded Platform Engineer passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe Embedded Platform et aider à construire la prochaine génération de produits de calcul multicaméra et haute performance. Dans ce rôle, vous allez concevoir, optimiser et mettre à l'échelle des systèmes qui repoussent les limites du traitement en temps réel et de l'intelligence des bords.

Vous serez l'expert en électronique, propriétaire de nos conceptions matérielles et façonnant les processus qui prennent des idées de concept à production. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires EMS, vous assurerez une qualité de produit exceptionnelle à l'échelle, tout en collaborant avec des partenaires de conception compétents pour mettre en place des systèmes innovants et de pointe. En chemin, vous allez créer des logiciels intelligents et des outils matériels pour rationaliser la fabrication et plonger profondément dans le développement difficile et approfondi du firmware.

Si vous aimez posséder des systèmes complexes de bout en bout et transformer des idées visionnaires en produits solides et réels, ce rôle est pour vous.

• Votre mission

  • Des prototypes pour notre prochaine génération de produits. Surveiller la fabrication de prototypes, y compris l'apport, le débogage et le retravail.

  • Maintenir le portefeuille de produits Sevensense et gérer les demandes de changement et les situations de fin de vie des composants. De plus, collaborer avec nos partenaires du SGE pour assurer une production harmonieuse de nos produits.

  • Valider vos conceptions au moyen d'essais approfondis sur les conditions thermiques, vibratoires, humidité, ESD, EMC et les défauts électriques.

  • Créer des stratégies et des exigences pour tester les PCBA et les assemblages plus importants en production.

Votre arrière-plan

  • Maîtrise en génie électrique acquise grâce à une combinaison de maîtrise en génie (électronique), expérience de travail ou projets pertinents.

  • Expérience avec Altium, KiCAD, Autodesk Fusion/EAGLE ou d'autres programmes CAO similaires pour la capture schématique, la conception des PCB et la maintenance des bibliothèques de composants.

  • Capable de simuler des circuits électriques dans des outils d'épices comme LTSpice ou similaires.

  • Compétence avec des outils de laboratoire électroniques standards comme les multimètres, les oscilloscopes, les analyseurs logiques, les analyseurs de spectre, les fers à souder, etc.

  • Connaissance d'au moins un des langages de programmation suivants : C, C++, Python

  • Compréhension de base du processus de conformité réglementaire avec les normes de sécurité de l'industrie, EMI/EMC et les règlements environnementaux.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


In this role as a Sales Engineer for Collaborative Robotics, you will take charge of selling ABB’s advanced robots across Switzerland. Your primary focus will be on engaging with a diverse range of customers, from small and medium enterprises to regional global companies, to cultivate business opportunities in the growing field of collaborative robotics. We are looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset, a passion for sales, and a practical approach to identifying and pursuing market opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Robotics & Discrete Automation Business Area in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Increasing sales volume and margin across the ABB Robotics Cobots portfolio while establishing and maintaining effective customer relationships through reliable service and a deep understanding of customer needs and ABB solutions.

  • Preparing sales plans and bids, managing key accounts (particularly in the consumer industry), and providing customers with tailored products, solutions, and services that align with volume, mix, and profitability targets.

  • Identifying and developing new market opportunities, monitoring customer and market trends, and collaborating with the Marketing team to create effective marketing activities. Furthermore, monitoring competitor activities, implementing appropriate response strategies, and sharing market intelligence insights with the Marketing and Sales organization.

  • Managing and expanding the partner network, ensuring efficient coordination of sales activities and transactions, and analyzing data to meet business objectives.

• Qualifications for the role

  • You are skilled in working with CRM tools such as SAP and SalesForce, with experience in the collaborative robotics market.

  • You have established skills in technical sales support, with first years of experience working in robotics or a related field.

  • You possess enhanced knowledge of customer relationship-building methodologies and are proficient in analyzing market trends and competitor activities.

  • You are passionate about customer-focused problem-solving and innovative thinking, paired with proficient organizational skills.

  • Degree in Engineering, Robotics, Business Administration (with technical focus), or equivalent professional experience in a technical environment.

  • You are proficient in communicating fluently in both English and German, ensuring clear and effective interactions.

  • Willingness to travel up to 60%, balancing onsite collaboration with virtual engagement to optimize customer relationships.

Benefits

  • Remote work & flexible work schedules

  • Minimum 27 days of vacation

  • Gym subscription

  • ABB Childcare Centers

  • Development opportunities

More about us

ABB’s Robotics Division is a pioneer in robotics and digital services, providing innovative solutions for a diverse range of industries, from automotive to electronics to logistics. Our intelligent robotics solutions support businesses well beyond traditional manufacturing, increasing productivity and flexibility in high-growth segments including healthcare, logistics, food and beverage, construction, and retail, including ecommerce.​

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it: A ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più snella e più pulita. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per voi, la vostra squadra, e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, vi daremo quello che dovete fare per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, la crescita prende grinta. Ma ad ABB, non correrete mai da soli. Gestire ciò che dirige il mondo. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del business di ABB Robotics, una società di robotica globale leader. Stiamo entrando in un nuovo capitolo emozionante come abbiamo annunciato il piano per SoftBank Group per acquisire ABB Robotics. SoftBank è un gruppo tecnologico riconosciuto a livello mondiale e investitore/operatore focalizzato su AI, robotica e computing di nuova generazione. Unendoci ora, sarete parte di un team pionieristico che modella il futuro della robotica—lavorando insieme a esperti di livello mondiale in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo. In questo ruolo di Ingegnere di Vendite per Robotica Collaborativa, vi occuperete della vendita di robot avanzati di ABB in tutta la Svizzera. Il vostro obiettivo primario sarà quello di coinvolgere una vasta gamma di clienti, dalle piccole e medie imprese alle aziende globali regionali, per coltivare opportunità di business nel crescente campo della robotica collaborativa. Stiamo cercando qualcuno con una mentalità imprenditoriale, una passione per le vendite e un approccio pratico per identificare e perseguire le opportunità di mercato. Questo ruolo contribuisce alla Robotics & Discrete Automation Business Area in Svizzera. Aumentare il volume e il margine di vendita attraverso il portafoglio ABB Robotics Cobots, stabilendo e mantenendo efficaci relazioni con i clienti attraverso un servizio affidabile e una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti e delle soluzioni ABB. Preparazione dei piani di vendita e delle offerte, gestione dei conti chiave (in particolare nell'industria dei consumatori) e fornitura dei clienti di prodotti, soluzioni e servizi su misura che si allineano con obiettivi di volume, mix e redditività. Identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di mercato, monitorare le tendenze del cliente e del mercato, e collaborare con il team Marketing per creare attività di marketing efficaci. Inoltre, il monitoraggio delle attività dei concorrenti, l'attuazione di strategie di risposta appropriate e la condivisione di informazioni di mercato con l'organizzazione Marketing e Vendite. • Qualifiche per il ruolo Siete abili nel lavorare con strumenti CRM come SAP e SalesForce, con esperienza nel mercato della robotica collaborativa. Hai acquisito competenze nel supporto tecnico delle vendite, con i primi anni di esperienza che lavorano nella robotica o in un campo correlato. Possiedi una conoscenza approfondita delle metodologie di costruzione delle relazioni con i clienti e sei esperto nell'analisi delle tendenze del mercato e delle attività concorrenti. È appassionato di problem solving e di pensiero innovativo, associato a competenze organizzative competenti. Le nostre soluzioni intelligenti di robotica supportano le aziende ben oltre la produzione tradizionale, aumentando la produttività e la flessibilità nei segmenti ad alta crescita, tra cui assistenza sanitaria, logistica, cibo e bevande, costruzione e vendita al dettaglio, tra cui ecommerce. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Applicare oggi o visitare www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed.

jobs.title: Applied Physicist (80%-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Department Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of power device physics with focus on dielectric insulation, breakdown phenomena, and other multi-physics topics

  • Contributing to and leading research projects towards sustainable solutions for the upcoming energy transformation, integration of renewable energies and energy storage systems

  • Applying commercial and in-house developed advanced simulation tools

  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments

  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications

  • Closely cooperating with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions

In this role, as a member of the Power Device Physics team, within Energy Technologies department, you work on the broad portfolio of ABB devices and systems from longer-term fundamental research up to time-critical questions in products. You provide novel and innovative solutions in the field of dielectric insulation in gases and solids with overlap to other multi-physical topics. Translating your findings from basic research on physical phenomena to prototypes demonstrating the technologies, you contribute to evolving applications in such fields as protection systems for sustainable energy generation and distribution. To achieve this, you utilize state-of-the-art simulations, perform scientific experiments, and apply the results to technology development and expert support of ABBs business divisions.


Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company, contribute to the definition of the team research roadmap, and to the management of the research projects.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in physics or electrical engineering, background in dielectric is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).

  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes

  • Experience in simulations, e.g., COMSOL

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)

​More about us

The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.

jobs.title: (Senior) Research Scientist in Software Systems Engineering (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: ABB Discovery Trainee – Mining Service (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Business Line Service Manager & Head of Service Operations

__

Are you ready for new adventures, eager to work on real projects, and driven to shape a productive and sustainable future?

Our ABB Discovery Trainee Program offers a unique entry opportunity with a dynamic role and a motivated team. Experience the operations of an international company firsthand during three different six months assignments over the course of a total of 18 months structured around the topic of Service in Mining.

ABB is a trusted partner to the global mining industry, delivering and supporting critical electrical, automation, and digital infrastructure across mining operations. Our installed base includes power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, motors, protection relays, automation systems, and industrial cybersecurity solutions that enable safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Through our global service organization, we help customers maximize asset performance, improve operational resilience, reduce downtime, and achieve their sustainability goals. As the mining industry continues its journey toward electrification, digitalization, and autonomous operations, ABB is uniquely positioned to develop innovative service solutions that create long-term value for customers.

Through a personalized, practice-oriented introduction, you will gain the confidence to work independently and as part of inclusive teams. ABB offers various development opportunities and training to enhance your skills and fast-track your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid.

Start date of the program is October 1, 2026. The selection process is taking place between June and July 2026.

Your main availabilities will be:

  • Assignment 1 – Switzerland: Collaborate with the Service Product Management, Service Sales, and Service Project Management teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of ABB's service portfolio, customer challenges, and business drivers. Working closely with technical and commercial stakeholders, support the identification of portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, particularly in the areas of automation, industrial cybersecurity, and electrification, and contribute to the development of future service solutions.
    Assignment 2 – International Assignment: Join an ABB unit abroad and work closely with local teams and customers to gain first-hand exposure to operational challenges, market dynamics, and customer needs. Contribute to identifying opportunities where ABB's service offerings can enhance reliability, productivity, sustainability, and operational performance.
    Assignment 3 – Switzerland: Shape your final assignment together with the business based on organizational priorities and your interests. Potential areas of focus would be in an engineering team, working closely with subject matter experts where you will strengthen your technical foundation while contributing to initiatives that support service innovation, portfolio development, and business growth. Additional collaboration with Product Management, Strategy, and Business Development teams may be included depending on business priorities.
  • Engage in challenging assignments that provide exposure to different functions, allowing you to build a broad understanding of ABB's service business while developing your technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities.
  • Benefit from personalized training, professional mentoring, executive exposure, and continuous support from the Discovery Program team, while receiving regular feedback to accelerate your development.
  • Actively participate in social events and team activities, build a global network across ABB, and become part of our vibrant Discovery Trainee community.

What we're looking for:

  • Master’s degree from university or applied science university in electrical engineering
  • Completed university studies and maximum three years of professional work experience before the start date October 1, 2026
  • Developed analytical and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of English; additional languages are considered an advantage.
  • Authorization to work in Switzerland is required
  • Be curious – sometimes, a question can be more powerful than an answer.
  • Be creative – challenge the status quo with a fresh perspective!
  • Be flexible – this step is just the beginning of a journey that will empower you to find your own path in our company.

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Aluminum and Cement and Food and Beverage.

The recruiting process is being led by Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snella e più pulita—e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che dirige il mondo. Questa posizione riporta a:

Local Business Line Service Manager & Head of Service Operations

Siete pronti per nuove avventure, desiderosi di lavorare su progetti reali, e spinti a plasmare un futuro produttivo e sostenibile? Vivi le operazioni di una società internazionale in prima persona durante tre diversi incarichi di sei mesi nel corso di un totale di 18 mesi strutturati intorno al tema del Servizio in Mining. La nostra base installata comprende sistemi di distribuzione di potenza, interruttori, trasformatori, motori, relè di protezione, sistemi di automazione e soluzioni di sicurezza informatica industriale che consentono operazioni sicure, affidabili ed efficienti. Attraverso la nostra organizzazione di servizi globale, aiutiamo i clienti a massimizzare le prestazioni degli asset, migliorare la resilienza operativa, ridurre i tempi di fermo e raggiungere i loro obiettivi di sostenibilità. Mentre l'industria mineraria continua il suo viaggio verso l'elettrificazione, la digitalizzazione e le operazioni autonome, ABB è in grado di sviluppare soluzioni di servizio innovative che creano valore a lungo termine per i clienti. Attraverso un'introduzione personalizzata, orientata alla pratica, si otterrà la fiducia di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di team inclusi. ABB offre varie opportunità di sviluppo e formazione per migliorare le tue abilità e velocizzare la tua carriera. Il processo di selezione si svolge tra giugno e luglio 2026. Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder tecnici e commerciali, sostenere l'identificazione di lacune di portafoglio e opportunità di crescita, in particolare nei settori dell'automazione, della sicurezza informatica industriale e dell'elettrificazione, e contribuire allo sviluppo di future soluzioni di servizio. Contribuisci all'individuazione delle opportunità in cui le offerte di servizi di ABB possono migliorare l'affidabilità, la produttività, la sostenibilità e le prestazioni operative. Potenziali aree di attenzione sarebbero in un team di ingegneria, lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti di materia in cui rafforzare la vostra fondazione tecnica, contribuendo a iniziative che supportano l'innovazione del servizio, lo sviluppo del portafoglio e la crescita aziendale. Ulteriori collaborazioni con i team di Product Management, Strategy e Business Development possono essere incluse a seconda delle priorità aziendali. < > > Impegnarsi in incarichi impegnativi che forniscono l'esposizione a diverse funzioni, permettendo di costruire una vasta comprensione del business dei servizi di ABB, sviluppando le vostre capacità tecniche, commerciali e di leadership. Approfitta della formazione personalizzata, del mentoring professionale, dell'esposizione esecutiva e del supporto continuo del team Discovery Program, mentre ricevi un feedback regolare per accelerare il tuo sviluppo. Partecipa attivamente agli eventi sociali e alle attività di squadra, costruisci una rete globale in tutta ABB e diventi parte della nostra vivace comunità di Discovery Trainee. Che cosa stiamo cercando:

<
    < < < > > laureato in scienze universitarie o applicata in ingegneria elettrica Studi universitari completi e massimo tre anni di esperienza professionale prima della data di inizio Ottobre 1, 2026 Capacità analitiche e di comunicazione sviluppate, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder tecnici e commerciali.
  • Conoscenza forte dell'inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio. Essere curiosi – a volte una domanda può essere più potente di una risposta. Essere flessibili – questo passo è solo l'inizio di un viaggio che vi permetterà di trovare il vostro percorso nella nostra azienda. La divisione Process Industries offre soluzioni complete di elettrificazione e automazione, prodotti specifici per il settore e servizi per il ciclo di vita in tutte le industrie. Ingegneria e fornitura di soluzioni di automazione da dispositivo a monitoraggio e controllo rendono i nostri clienti ottenere più fuori del loro investimento; soluzioni di digitalizzazione tra cui operazioni collaborative e realtà aumentata contribuiscono a migliorare la produttività degli impianti e delle imprese, ridurre i costi di manutenzione e di energia. Il nostro portafoglio ingegneristico, project management, servizi e soluzioni copre una vasta gamma di settori - Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Alluminio e Cemento e Food and Beverage. Il processo di reclutamento è guidato da Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner di ABB Svizzera Ltd. Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Questo è il motivo per cui accogliamo le persone da tutti i background e le esperienze.

Bist du bereit für neue Abenteuer, eifrig darauf, an echten Projekten zu arbeiten und eine produktive und nachhaltige Zukunft zu gestalten?

Unser ABB Discovery Trainee Programm bietet eine einzigartige Einstiegsmöglichkeit mit einer dynamischen Rolle und einem motivierten Team. Erleben Sie den Betrieb eines internationalen Unternehmens aus erster Hand während drei verschiedenen sechsmonatigen Einsätzen im Laufe von insgesamt 18 Monaten rund um das Thema Service im Bergbau.

ABB ist ein zuverlässiger Partner der globalen Bergbauindustrie und liefert und unterstützt wichtige elektrische, automatisierte und digitale Infrastruktur in allen Bergbaubetrieben. Unsere installierte Basis umfasst Stromverteilungssysteme, Schaltanlagen, Transformatoren, Motoren, Schutzrelais, Automatisierungssysteme und industrielle Cybersicherheitslösungen, die einen sicheren, zuverlässigen und effizienten Betrieb ermöglichen. Durch unsere globale Serviceorganisation helfen wir unseren Kunden, die Anlagenperformance zu maximieren, die betriebliche Widerstandsfähigkeit zu verbessern, Ausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und ihre Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen. Während die Bergbauindustrie ihren Weg in Richtung Elektrifizierung, Digitalisierung und autonomen Betrieb fortsetzt, ist ABB einzigartig positioniert, um innovative Servicelösungen zu entwickeln, die einen langfristigen Wert für die Kunden schaffen.

Durch eine personalisierte, praxisorientierte Einführung gewinnen Sie das Selbstvertrauen, selbstständig und als Teil inklusiver Teams zu arbeiten. ABB bietet verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Schulungen an, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere zu beschleunigen.

    Auftrag 2 – Internationaler Auftrag: Steigen Sie einer ABB-Einheit im Ausland bei und arbeiten Sie eng mit lokalen Teams und Kunden zusammen, um sich aus erster Hand mit operativen Herausforderungen, Marktdynamik und Kundenbedürfnissen vertraut zu machen. Tragen Sie dazu bei, Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, mit denen das Serviceangebot von ABB die Zuverlässigkeit, Produktivität, Nachhaltigkeit und operative Leistung verbessern kann.
